facts.statement: ∀ (M N X Y : Type*) [SMul M X] [SMul N Y] (φ φ' : M → N) (h : φ = φ') (f : X →ₑ[φ] Y) (g : X →ₑ[φ'] Y), (∀ x : X, (VTask.ofEq h f) x = g x) → (∀ x : X, f x = g x)
